'''Staven''' was a [[Domani]] soldier under the command of [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
He dies in the battle against [[Shadowspawn]] outside [[Maradon]].

== Trivia ==
* Staven is named for Steven Connelly, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
